name: PM-KISAN
summary: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme for income support to land holding farmer families.
source: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
summary: The official PMFBY portal provides access to crop insurance applications and related services.
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop
summary: The Per Drop More Crop component focuses on water use efficiency through micro irrigation, including drip and sprinkler irrigation.
source: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: The official Soil Health Card portal provides soil testing, soil health card, and nutrient analysis services.
source: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: PM-KUSUM
summary: The official PM-KUSUM portal identifies the scheme and states that it is implemented by state government departments.
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India
